id: title:VojtechBartos:clear cached slack profiles on app uninstall

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a route and cache clearing function to handle Slack app uninstallation events, potentially clearing cached Slack profiles when an app is uninstalled.
review.reason: Adds a route and cache clearing function to handle Slack app uninstallation events, potentially clearing cached Slack profiles when an app is uninstalled.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the implementation of the Slack app uninstallation event handler or the database clearing logic, only the route and the cache clearing function. The chunk also does not include the Slack app backend implementation, so it is not possible to assess the tier of this change.
